stories.headline: The friend who always says yes

sentences.text: You met Mara through sunday crag crew, trading one-liners about thrifting long before either of you suggested hanging out.
The first real plan was small: Seoul, a late start, nobody in a hurry.
By spring the messages came daily, mostly logistics dressed up as jokes.
You started a running bit about thrifting that never really ended.
Mara was the one who remembered your birthday without a reminder.
Seoul went from a maybe to a booked weekend in about forty minutes.
Half the photos are blurry and all of them are good.
